pr_body:
This adds cancellation checks to rescore phase. This cancellation checks for the parent task being cancelled and for timeout checks.

The assumption is that rescore is always significantly more expensive than a regular query, so we check for timeout as frequently as the most frequent check in ExitableDirectoryReader.

For LTR, we check on hit inference. Maybe we should also check for per feature extraction?

For QueryRescorer, we check in the combine method.

closes: https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/114955
pr_title: Add timeout and cancellation check to rescore phase

review_comment: Using a timeout here can be flaky. Could we use CountDownLatch and task cancellation instead? Also, we can define ScoreFunctionSpec in `SearchPlugin#getScoreFunctions()` to simulate the plugin in question.

@dnhatn I don't know how to do a countdown latch as this test could serialize. I can add an entirely new suite of tests if we want, but I thought it prudent to get a real integration test in to verify search responses are what we expect (this shows some bugs in my original approach).
